title: [Bug]: Non cisco T2 devices failing test_power_off_reboot.py due to no duthosts
author: Javier-Tan
body:
### Issue Description

PR #16736 reintroduces bug that we previously fixed in https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/16313 by making it only applying it to Cisco chassis.

### Results you see

`duthosts = None` causing errors

### Results you expected to see

Let all T2 devices have duthosts fix

### Is it platform specific

generic
